reviews.text: Horrible grooming!!!! I’ve been to several other Petsmarts to get my Husky bathed, brushed, and I pay extra to furminate and de-shed him. All other locations have done a great job of getting his excess fur off. Canoga Park didn’t even brush him out!! They left so much loose fur on him that my car was COVERED in piles of loose fur. I took him back to have it re-done and they still did not get it all off. I have so much fur floating around my car and house and am so disgusted and angry that I paid $100 for this. Will NEVER go back to this location!!!!

Johanna at PetSmart Grooming in Canoga Park is absolutely amazing! She always does an excellent job grooming my mini Goldendoodle, Maui. Every time I pick her up, she looks adorable, beautifully groomed, and so well cared for.

Johanna is incredibly dedicated to her work, and it truly shows in the quality of her grooming. She is professional, attentive, kind, and has excellent customer service skills. I always feel comfortable leaving Maui in her care because I know she takes the time to make sure he looks and feels her best.

It’s not easy to find a groomer you completely trust with your fur baby, and Johanna has definitely earned that trust. Even if I moved to another city, I would happily make the drive to Canoga Park just to have her continue grooming Maui!

Thank you, Johanna, for always taking such wonderful care of Maui. We truly appreciate you and highly recommend you! 🐾❤️

Terribly unprofessional experience at the grooming salon today (Friday, Aug 28th at 11:00 AM). I brought my dog in for his scheduled appointment, and the assigned stylist, Eli P, was incredibly rude from the very start. She flat out refused to check him in and lied, claiming he was growling. My dog is extremely docile and friendly with humans. Ironically, my other dog—the one who actually gets nervous and growls—was taken in right next to us by a different, very kind employee without any issues. Eli P then claimed they were overloaded with dogs, but within 3 minutes, the salon was practically empty with only 3 dogs left, and she walked right out of the store to take her lunch. She clearly fabricated excuses just to avoid working before her break. I spoke with the store manager, but he did not seem interested in addressing the situation. Unacceptable customer service, lying to clients, and terrible attitude. Avoid Eli P if you want honest, professional care for your pets at this location. After the incident, I took my dog to a self-service wash on Victory Blvd. and bathed him myself.

UPDATED
I returned to PetSmart the very next day and had another standout experience—this time with Todd, the store manager.

He noticed my three-month-old puppy, Bruno, sitting in the shopping cart as he walked by the aisle. Normally I wouldn’t put a dog in a cart, but since Bruno hasn’t had his third round of vaccinations yet, I had been advised not to put him on the floor. He had just come over to see if we found everything we needed and played with Bruno.

We were shopping for Blue Buffalo puppy food, and Todd suggested going with a larger bag to get better value. While the store happened to be out of stock on the bigger size, his recommendation was spot-on, and the two smaller bags we purchased worked perfectly for what we needed. He also took the time to ask if I had the puppy guide, which showed he was thinking ahead and making sure I had all the right resources.

On top of that, the checkout staff was efficient and genuinely friendly—they got us through the line quickly without sacrificing good service. We were also able to take advantage of the promotion running through 4/22 again, which resets daily, and everything went smoothly.

Between Todd’s attentiveness and the strong team at checkout, this was another excellent visit. It’s clear there’s good leadership in this store, and it shows in the overall customer experience.

THE DAY BEFORE
I had a really great experience at PetSmart today thanks to Travis. He went out of his way to make sure I got the most value out of my purchase by encouraging me to download the PetSmart app and take advantage of a promotion that runs through 4/22.

What stood out was that he didn’t just mention it—he actually walked me through the entire process step by step, making sure everything was set up correctly and that my purchase was properly reflected in my account. That level of attention to detail and follow-through is rare.

The service was professional, patient, and genuinely helpful. Experiences like this absolutely influence where I choose to shop, and today’s visit made me far more inclined to return to PetSmart over competitors. Travis represents the kind of customer service that keeps people coming back.
